executiveSummary: GM0226's 2025 code, Duiven name, Gelderland province, Gelderland-Midden safety-region assignment, 24,942-person control total, 14 neighbourhoods, three BAG places and five settlement labels are coherent. All ten canonical exercises execute deterministically at T+0/6/12/24/48/72 across power, water, drainage, gas, telecom, mobility, facilities and supply; exact-zero input, finite bounds, local reconciliation, causal-ledger closure and layer invariance pass. The current route rule also correctly limits four NWB links to Mobility and explicitly assumed road-logistics/Supply. Release nevertheless remains correction-required. The named-major-river preset holds a generic derived screen at severity 0.744540 and internal flood field 2.398002 through T+72, grows affected population-equivalent from 15,488 at T+24 to 16,551 at T+72 and accumulates 938,752.585 local pre-network person-hours without a selected Rhine/Pannerdensch Kanaal/IJssel boundary condition, Pannerdense Waard-Westervoort defence state, breach/overtopping path, Gemaal de Liemers state, connected footprint, arrival or recession. Pluvial, river, coastal, heat and wildfire reuse the exact same complete neighbourhood order. A controlled source inside official BRT loofbos in Loo ranks its containing neighbourhood only 11th while Noord remains first. The WRIJ Duiven Atlas publishes distinct T100/T1000 rain-depth, building, road-passability, heat and flood-probability layers, and REV identifies a Seveso activity plus other external-safety activities in Duiven, but none drives the ten presets. Public water, provider, grid, utility-geometry, care, education, antenna, traffic and facility records are useful context, never complete operational topology, capacity, state or restoration. Unavailable or security-sensitive facts must remain Unknown or transparently synthetic.

evidenceSources.title: Kerncijfers wijken en buurten 2025, table 86165NED, OData API
supports: The fresh official GM0226 municipality row gives Duiven, 24,942 residents, density 736 per square kilometre, 5,664 residents aged 65+, 3,234 one-person households and 10,925 households.

The 14 generated neighbourhood source rows sum to 24,955 residents (+13, +0.052%), 5,655 residents aged 65+, 3,245 one-person households and 10,930 households; simulation detail preserves the official 24,942 control total without silently rewriting source rows.
Largest source rows are Zuidoost 4,415, West 3,495, Zuidwest 3,060, Oud Zuid 2,685, De Vergert 2,365 and Groessen 2,050.

The OData service is machine-readable under CC BY 4.0. CBS labels the 2025 table as receiving quarterly additions; randomized rounding, suppression and incomplete variables remain source semantics, not zero.

Simulation role is official demographic/context and allocation denominator only. Registered residence is not incident-time presence, evacuation demand, vulnerability, care need, workers/visitors or identified customers.

evidenceSources.title: CBS Gebiedsindelingen 2025 non-generalized geometry and national settlement/transport reference services
evidenceSources.edition: 2025 boundary; current generated BAG, BRT, NWB, ProRail and GTFS reference editions
supports: Fresh full-resolution GM0226 geometry is one MultiPolygon component with one ring and 1,773 positions, valid 1 January through 31 December 2025, with bbox [5.965775466700744, 51.912333958978756, 6.0688524867306635, 51.981859315924794]. The generated overview preserves one component/ring with only 76 positions and contains centre [6.017166786276172, 51.947674823151395].
The bundle has six districts, 14 neighbourhoods and BAG places Duiven, Groessen and Loo Gld. BRT adds De Eng and Helhoek, yielding five labels across two buurtschappen and three woonkernen.

Four logical links are A12 to Westervoort, N338 and N810 to Zevenaar, and A12 to Zevenaar, with 260/150/150/260 scenario-unit edge ceilings. ProRail station Duiven lies inside GM0226 and the generated GTFS bundle has 42 stop areas.

CBS boundary OGC is half-yearly/CC BY 4.0; BAG is daily/Public Domain Mark; BRT is CC BY 4.0; NWB OGC/download is monthly/CC0 1.0; ProRail reference geometry is manually refreshed/CC0 1.0. The generated OVapi GTFS feed is best effort/free-use with no SLA.
These products are reference geometry and timetable context, not incident-time route passability, train/bus operation, measured throughput, evacuation capacity, utility topology or repair access.

evidenceSources.title: Ramp of incident and municipal InnoFase/business-area context
supports: The municipality says siren, NL-Alert and sound vehicles provide warnings and that electricity, water, internet and emergency services may be unavailable in the first hours or days; it recommends a 72-hour kit and plan. This is preparedness guidance, not an activated site or resource ledger.

The current page https://www.duiven.nl/kavels-en-bedrijventerreinen identifies 60-hectare InnoFase north of the A12 for environmental categories 4 and 5, with AVR, PreZero and the wastewater treatment works, and identifies De Nieuweling on the Arnhem-Doetinchem railway north of Groessen.

The current page https://www.duiven.nl/coalitieakkoord-gemeente-duiven-2023-2026 calls for public space resilient to extreme heat, drought and rainfall and notes increased care demand with ageing and workforce shortages.

The current page https://www.duiven.nl/hitte-nationaal-hitteplan-van-kracht describes elderly people, young children and chronically ill residents as heat-vulnerable. Its dated activation is observed guidance, not a generic exercise observation or T+72 forecast.

Municipal HTML pages have no machine incident API, standard reuse licence or contractual operational refresh cadence. Their correct role is local planning/response context and validation, never live capacity or simulated hazard intensity.

evidenceSources.publisher: Waterschap Rijn en IJssel (WRIJ) / Het Waterschapshuis (HWH)
evidenceSources.title: Klimaatatlas Duiven, Pannerdense Waard-Westervoort defence project and managed-water registers
evidenceSources.edition: Duiven StoryMap modified 9 October 2025; child rain maps modified 2 October 2025; current defence/project pages and HWH deployment snapshot inspected September 2026
supports: The public Duiven Atlas distinguishes short 2050 rain events of one and two hours, gives 70 mm in one hour as an example, and exposes WRIJ rain-depth T100/T1000 raster layers 301/302, T100 building-vulnerability layer 95, T100/T1000 road-passability layers 60/61, Liemers heat-stress layer 54 and flood-probability/building layers 62/63/65 through https://opengeo.wrij.nl/arcgis/rest/services/Klimaat/KEA_DATA/MapServer.

Those services are integration-ready ArcGIS Map/Query endpoints in EPSG:28992; road/building layers are features and depth/heat layers are rasters. Public item/service metadata states no standard reuse licence, contractual cadence, native cell size or complete NoData contract, so they must begin as official static scenario/context and retain T100/T1000 plus one-/two-hour event semantics.

The current page https://www.wrij.nl/projecten/versterken-dijk-pannerden-westervoort says the approximately 9 km dike from Pannerdense Waard to the A12 IJssel bridge was found not yet ready for future water levels; detailed design runs 2025-2028 and construction 2029-2032. That is assessment/project context, explicitly not a current breach or failure state.

The official image text at https://www.wrij.nl/paragraph/4798/modal states Gemaal de Liemers helps prevent Westervoort, Duiven and Zevenaar from flooding. The simulator selects no pump state, drainage area, receiving-water level, backup or dewatering path.

The generated overview contains 47 HWH point records: three sewer pumps (Duiven 568, Groessen 70, Loo 47 in unnormalised source units), RWZI Nieuwgraaf, ten surface-water pumps and 33 weirs. HWH IMWA is national/weekly and DAMO contributor-dependent, both CC BY-SA 4.0, at https://api.pdok.nl/hwh/waterschappen-kunstwerken-imwa/ogc/v2 and https://api.pdok.nl/hwh/waterschappen-waterketen-damo/ogc/v1.

Registers, project geometry and a realised-status label do not establish completeness, connected catchments, compatible capacity, operating/control state, pressure/quality, emergency power or restoration. Boundary-edge counts can differ between generalized and full CBS geometry.

evidenceSources.title: Regional risk profiles and Crisisbeheersing policy 2025-2026
evidenceSources.edition: Policy adopted 11 September 2024 for 2025-2026; current risk page accessed September 2026
supports: VGGM identifies flooding and epidemic/pandemic as its largest regional risks, followed by nature fire, cybercrime, utility disruption and animal disease.

The current plan page https://vggm.nl/node/1268 provides the regional crisis plan; the regional organization covers fire, public health, ambulance, GHOR and crisis response across 15 municipalities.

These pages and fixed PDFs are authoritative mechanism, governance and preparedness context. They have no machine event API, open-data licence, activation feed or fixed operational cadence and do not provide local probability, incident state, staffing, resources or restoration promises.

evidenceSources.title: ViA15 construction and valid-time current road-situation data
evidenceSources.edition: Project notice 22 May 2026; NDW publication 2 September 2026 15:25 UTC
supports: Rijkswaterstaat says the area between Duiven and Zevenaar is materially changing during ViA15 construction: the N810 moves through a temporary bypass beneath a construction bridge, with construction logistics and temporary local closures. The A15 will connect to the A12 between Duiven and Zevenaar and is expected to open by the end of 2031.

The current project page https://www.rijkswaterstaat.nl/wegen/projectenoverzicht/a12-a15-doortrekken-knooppunt-ressen-oudbroeken/doelen-en-resultaten identifies a new De Liemers interchange, connection to N810, a Pannerdensch Kanaal bridge and a depressed alignment at Groessen and Helhoek.

The app's 2 September 2026 NDW DATEX snapshot contains one real, certain VehicleObstruction/other point inside the generated Duiven outline at [5.9987745, 51.968056], with unknown severity, no supplied end time and version time 15:23:32 UTC. It is observed current context, not proof of which logical edge is closed or a T+72 state.

NDW's public current-situations download is near-real-time/valid-time aware and CC0 unless otherwise stated. It should be integrated through explicit geometry/time matching for Mobility and Supply only; missing or unmatched messages never prove an open road, and observations must not be replayed into an unaligned exercise.

evidenceSources.title: REV external-safety WFS and BRT Top10NL land-cover evidence
evidenceSources.edition: Live public WFS queried September 2026; BRT feature source vintage 2023, registered June 2024
supports: The public REV WFS is machine-readable as GeoJSON/GML/CSV/Shape. Duiven-addressed records include Synerlogic B.V. as a Seveso activity (NL.IMEV.ODRN.RRGS_7096), AVR Duiven, an ammonia refrigeration installation, LPG/LNG refuelling, gas reception, packaged storage, wind turbines and RWZI Nieuwgraaf digestion.

REV source records retain activity class, authority, registration/begin-validity time and geometry, and the service publishes fire, explosion, toxic-cloud, risk-contour, activity and pipeline layers. WFS capabilities state no licence, fees, access restrictions or fixed refresh cadence; source timestamps vary and data quality remains the source authority's responsibility.

REV is the strongest public integration for external-safety context, but it is not incident telemetry, inventory at a moment, wind/plume, alarm, suppression, exposure, route state or operator capacity. An industrial/toxic exercise needs a selected incident and valid-time source term before it can affect simulation.

BRT feature https://api.pdok.nl/kadaster/brt-top10nl/ogc/v1/collections/terrein_vlak/items/dfb51dcc-84fd-5e7c-83b5-f148ff4bc529?f=json is official loofbos. Audit point [5.996655039551414, 51.91486794732262] lies inside it and BU02260601 Loo Gld. BRT OGC is national/current topographic context under CC BY 4.0, but feature vintage is not fuel, moisture, access, ignition, perimeter or suppression state.

evidenceSources.publisher: Stichting Mijn Aansluiting / Liander / Netbeheer Nederland / RIVM / DUO / RDI / Rijkswaterstaat
evidenceSources.title: Machine-readable utility, capacity, care, education, telecom and observation context
evidenceSources.edition: Public sources and deployment snapshots inspected 2 September 2026; RIVM acute-care questionnaire 2026 v1.1
supports: Mijn Aansluiting's live Public Domain WMS/WFS returns Liander electricity (record 24 March 2026), Liander gas (17 December 2025), Vitens drinking water and Ziggo fixed media (both 7 September 2025) at Duiven's reference point; no sewer match was returned. Provider polygons are responsibility context, not connectivity, quality, capacity or state.

Liander's public ArcGIS service offers high-, medium- and low-voltage cables/stations and gas-pipe geometry in its partial service area under CC BY 4.0; the publisher states no fixed geometry refresh cadence. It does not establish a connected operational feeder/pressure topology, load, spare capacity, switching/valve state, outage or repair.

The one NBNL postcode sample maps to Liander service area OS ZEVENAAR 10-3i and reports planning capacity, 64 withdrawal and 47 injection requests, 28 projects and earliest project year 2029. Capacity/project information is at least quarterly and queue information monthly; the public frontend JSON endpoint is not contractually stable and the exact open-data licence identifier is unstated. One point is not municipality coverage or outage telemetry.

No RIVM acute-care point lies inside GM0226; the closest registered site by straight line is Rijnstate Arnhem at about 9.436 km, registered as 24/7 emergency and acute-obstetric care with 24 treatment rooms and 35,842 reported 2025 visits. RIVM v1.1 was published 3 July 2026 under CC0 and is fixed questionnaire context, not live reachability, acceptance, staffing, occupancy, diversion or backup.

The generated current context assigns 18 DUO education locations (national daily around 06:15, Creative Commons Attribution version unspecified), 43 RDI antenna sites (live statutory WFS, licence/cadence unstated) and six coarse KVK/PDOK government points (Public Domain Mark, partial). None is a confirmed shelter, crisis support point, staffed facility, coverage map or operational capacity.

Waterinfo generally supplies ten-minute point observations under CC0 but assigns zero water-level/discharge points to Duiven; that is NoData, not zero river level or flood risk. Energieonderbrekingen.nl is the strongest live electricity/gas disruption API, but GET requires approved OAuth read:disruptions access; this deployment has none, so current outage state remains Unknown.

scenarioMatrix.summary: All ten canonical presets execute at all six mandatory checkpoints for all eight services.
notes: MUNICIPALITY_AUDIT_CODE=GM0226 pnpm audit:model passed one file/two tests in 37.12 seconds (36.90 seconds test time) on the final current engine, covering severe-storm, pluvial-flood, river-flood, coastal-flood, heatwave, winter-storm, cyberattack, earthquake, wildfire and compound at T+0/6/12/24/48/72 across all eight services.
The canonical apps/web/src/scenarios.ts factory delegates to the sim-core presets, preventing web/core preset drift.

At T+24 modeled severity / affected population-equivalent / cumulative local pre-network person-hours are storm 0.078338 / 6,267 / 88,423.898; pluvial 0.260661 / 3,741 / 92,184.603; river 0.744540 / 15,488 / 238,454.663; coastal 0.071018 / 14 / 38,636.785; heat 0.084731 / 1,278 / 54,766.393.

A focused reproduction passed one file/one test in 37.75 seconds (37.66 seconds import; 1 ms test) and recorded local ranks, all-service balances, causal closure, exact-zero input, route scope and a controlled BRT forest source.

Headless Chromium at 1440x900 and 390x844 selected Duiven, river flood, Drinking water and T+24/T+72 with zero page/console/local-resource errors and no horizontal overflow. It announced 42% water availability at both checkpoints.

numericalInvariants.summary: Outputs are finite, bounded, deterministic, exact at zero input, layer-invariant and locally reconciled.
notes: Exact-zero intensity gives zero maximum severity, affected population-equivalent and event-attributable person-hours for every preset.
Compound T+24 has 14 rows summing to population 24,942 and affected 15,729; maximum all-service reconciliation error is 3.552713678800501e-15.

Changing the selected service layer does not mutate municipality hazard, pressure or affected values; event-attributable burden is a matched no-event local pre-network integral rather than observed customer hours.

spatialPlausibility.summary: One shared synthetic neighbourhood seed contradicts rain, river, heat and source-responsive fire mechanisms.
notes: Pluvial, river, coastal, heat and wildfire have the exact same full 14-neighbourhood order: Noord, Groessen, Oud Zuid, Bedrijventerrein, De Ploen and West lead; Loo Gld ranks 11th and Het Broek last.

The order does not sample WRIJ T100/T1000 depth, buildings, roads, flood probability, defence, pump, heat or drought evidence. Bedrijventerrein ranks fourth despite five registered residents, showing that rank is not an exposed-population ordering either.

With source [5.996655039551414, 51.91486794732262] inside official BRT loofbos and BU02260601 Loo Gld, municipal direct fire peaks 0.396012 at T+11, yet the source neighbourhood ranks 11/14 and Noord remains first.
The compound output declares unsupported=[] although none of the nine local hazard families has a GM0226 calibration contract.

notes: Current engine inspection gives route counts Power 0, Water 0, Drainage 0, Gas 0, Telecom 0, Mobility 4, Facilities 0 and Supply 4. NWB no longer masquerades as non-road utility or facility topology.

River T+24 availability is power 0.368129, water 0.419267, drainage 0.290706, gas 0.666693, telecom 0.391678, mobility 0.245393, facilities 0.550332 and supply 0.444525. At T+72 all but facilities are exactly unchanged; facilities falls to 0.334332.

HWH/WRIJ objects, Liander geometry, provider polygons, one grid-planning postcode, antennas, education/government points, GTFS and external care are non-causal context. They do not establish feeders/pipes/backhaul/catchments, unit-compatible capacities, customer load, contamination/pressure, controls, backup, state or restoration.
Unavailable or security-sensitive physical topology must remain Unknown. The smallest safe fallback is an explicitly non-spatial synthetic service index with uncertainty and no operator attribution.

causalTrace.summary: Municipality, hazard, dependency and eligible-route ledgers close, while attribution is correctly identified as modeled rather than empirical.
notes: Focused and mandatory checks verify deterministic counterfactuals, dimension shares, service-pressure contributions and local/network identities for every scenario/service/checkpoint combination.
The trace states that system-pressure weights are model assumptions and cumulative event-attributable person-hours exclude intermunicipal transfers.
Eligible Mobility/Supply route-flow arithmetic closes and selected layer is invariant. Arithmetic traceability does not make road logistics observed or make non-road service indices physical.
Exact affected people-equivalent and burden are modeled pressure proxies, not identified customers, casualties, displacement, health outcomes or economic loss.

recovery72h.summary: Standing-water repair guards are internally consistent, but Duiven river/compound continuity is not tied to an event, pump/defence state or action ledger.
notes: River T+72 retains severity 0.744540, internal flood field 2.398002, 16,551 affected population-equivalent and 938,752.585 person-hours; all service recovery factors remain zero.

Power, water, drainage, gas, telecom, mobility and supply availability are exactly identical at river T+24 and T+72, while facilities worsens from 0.550332 to 0.334332. Desktop and mobile UI round water to the same 42% at both checkpoints.

Storm, pluvial and winter forcing clear by T+72; heat remains active while affected rounds to zero; cyber decays and canonical wildfire smoke clears. These are deterministic exercise mechanics, not Duiven, VGGM, WRIJ or operator response/restoration promises.
No selected dike/breach, Gemaal de Liemers/dewatering, utility switching, A12/N810/rail status, care/support-point activation, crew, backup, stock or completed action calibrates T+24/T+72.

findings.summary: Generated identity, safety-region membership, population control, neighbourhoods, places and settlements are coherent.
findings.evidence: CBS gives 24,942 residents; 14 neighbourhood source rows sum to 24,955 (+0.052%) and model allocation reconciles exactly to 24,942 without rewriting published rows. Code, name, province, Gelderland-Midden assignment, three BAG places and two BRT labels agree. Full and overview boundaries retain one component/ring.
findings.action: Retain official editions, full-versus-overview purpose, source-versus-allocated totals, CBS rounding/suppression and null semantics on every refresh.

findings.summary: The named-major-river screen produces severe persistent Duiven inundation without a selected river event, defence or pumping state.
findings.evidence: River T+24/T+72 severity is 0.744540 and the internal flood field is 2.398002. T+72 reports 16,551 affected population-equivalent, 938,752.585 event-attributable person-hours, 29.071% drainage and 24.539% mobility availability with zero recovery for every service. No Rhine/Pannerdensch Kanaal/IJssel hydrograph, gauge/datum, Pannerdense Waard-Westervoort segment state, breach/overtopping, connected footprint, Gemaal de Liemers state, arrival, recession or dewatering path is selected. WRIJ's strengthening project says assessed dike sections are not ready for future levels, not that a breach is occurring.
findings.action: Mark direct local river impact Unsupported/Unknown until WRIJ/Rijkswaterstaat/VGGM approve a named, versioned hydraulic event with source level/datum, boundary conditions, defence/failure state, connected depth/stress footprint, pump/dewatering state, arrival/recession, uncertainty and NoData. Keep the scalar only as a non-operational diagnostic and do not present its internal flood field as observed metres.

findings.summary: The allocator reuses one complete neighbourhood order across unrelated rain, river, coast, heat and fire mechanisms.
findings.evidence: All five tested mechanisms rank the 14 rows identically, led by Noord, Groessen, Oud Zuid and five-resident Bedrijventerrein, while Loo Gld is 11th and Het Broek last. None samples the WRIJ depth, building, road, flood-probability or heat layers. Compound reports unsupported=[] despite absent local calibration.
findings.action: Mark all nine GM0226 local hazard families unsupported and suppress precise hotspots until mechanism-specific, versioned, geometry-weighted surfaces include unit, resolution, coverage, NoData, edition/effective time, licence, uncertainty and declared simulation role.

findings.summary: Pluvial output does not consume Duiven's public duration-specific depth and road/building impact evidence.
findings.evidence: Pluvial T+24 reports severity 0.260661, flood field 0.360915, 3,741 affected and 92,184.603 person-hours, then zero rain/flood/affected at T+72 and 208,107.518 cumulative person-hours. WRIJ exposes distinct one-/two-hour 2050 T100/T1000 rain-depth rasters plus building and road-passability features, but the simulator samples none and instead repeats the river/heat/fire rank.
findings.action: Integrate WRIJ KEA layers 301/302/95/60/61 as official static scenario/context first. Preserve EPSG:28992, T100/T1000, one-/two-hour event definition, depth/passability class, raster/feature resolution, model vintage, transparent/NoData cells, uncertainty, source record time, licence clearance and affectsSimulation=false. Enable causal use only after WRIJ/municipality validation against full geometry and local sewer/surface-water conditions.

findings.summary: Direct wildfire allocation does not follow a controlled source inside official Loo loofbos.
findings.evidence: The canonical wildfire is locally remote-smoke-only and peaks T+11 at severity 0.119386/smoke 0.319007 with zero direct flame. In a focused test, source [5.996655039551414, 51.91486794732262] inside BRT loofbos and BU02260601 produces direct municipal fire 0.396012 at T+11, but Loo Gld ranks 11/14 and Noord remains first.
findings.action: Require official eligible vegetation plus selected ignition/perimeter, fuel/moisture, valid-time wind, access and suppression-water inputs for direct flame. Enforce source/perimeter-responsive allocation and keep remote smoke separate; BRT land use is only eligibility/context, and absent ignition/perimeter is Unknown.

findings.summary: A locally material InnoFase/Seveso external-safety pathway is absent from the canonical scenario and UI scope.
findings.evidence: The municipality places AVR, PreZero and RWZI Nieuwgraaf on 60-hectare environmental-category 4/5 InnoFase. REV identifies Synerlogic as a Seveso activity and publishes AVR, ammonia refrigeration, gas, LPG/LNG, storage, digestion, wind-turbine and risk-contour context. None of the ten presets selects an industrial fire, explosion or toxic-cloud source, and the inspector exposes only generic/pipeline external-safety context rather than these local activity records.
findings.action: Add a clearly scoped industrial/external-safety exercise adapter or disclose the omission prominently. Ingest REV WFS activity and attention/risk-contour layers as official register context with source authority and validity timestamps; only a selected incident source term, substance/inventory band, release/fire state, event-valid KNMI wind, plume/thermal model and authority approval may drive exposure.

findings.summary: Precise water, power, gas, telecom and facility impacts lack connected operational topology, capacity and state.

Use event-valid KNMI radar/weather and FDSN origin plus approved ground-motion/site response; WRIJ heat/drought surfaces with time-of-day/vulnerability semantics; asset exposure for storm/winter; and a named, authorized cyber target/architecture. residualLimitations: This is an audit of a deterministic first-72-hour planning exercise, not a warning, probability estimate, hydraulic assessment, evacuation order, outage statement, industrial incident statement, clinical-capacity statement or operator restoration commitment.

No expert-selected Rhine/Pannerdensch Kanaal/IJssel hydrograph, gauge/datum, defence state, breach/overtopping path, connected footprint, arrival/recession, Gemaal de Liemers/dewatering state, verified depth unit or NoData mask drives GM0226; the internal flood field is not an observation.

WRIJ KEA rain, road/building, heat and flood products are official regional scenario/context with public access but incomplete standard licence, cadence, raster-cell and NoData metadata; they are not current observations or T+72 forecasts.

The generalized 76-position CBS outline is suitable for overview rendering, not detailed dike, flood, industrial, forest, road, rail, building or asset intersection; analytics must use the 1,773-position official geometry.

CBS small-area values can be rounded or suppressed; the +13 population source-sum difference is publication semantics, null fields remain Unknown and registered residents do not equal incident-time presence.

HWH and WRIJ registers do not establish complete connected catchments, compatible capacity units, current pump/weir/RWZI/defence state, control logic, pressure, contamination, emergency power or restoration.

No complete public causal Liander feeder/switching, Vitens pipe/pressure/quality, gas pressure-district, municipal sewer, telecom backhaul or facility topology is consumed; unavailable or security-sensitive detail remains Unknown.

NWB roads, current NDW messages, ProRail geometry, GTFS stops and ViA15 plans do not establish incident-time road/rail/bus operation, bridge/interchange state, evacuation throughput or repair access. Current/unmatched traffic cannot be projected to T+72.
No internal RIVM acute-care point exists; straight-line distance to Rijnstate is not ambulance travel time, reachability, acceptance, staffing, occupancy, diversion or generator/fuel endurance.

Government and education locations are not confirmed crisis centres, emergency support points, shelters, care sites or distribution points. Public preparedness guidance is not an activation/capacity register.

Provider territories and one NBNL postcode sample identify responsibility/planning context only, not complete municipal coverage, topology, current load, outage, switching, reserve or restoration. Missing sewer matches remain NoData.

Zero local Waterinfo, PM2.5 and seismic records is a time/point/coverage result, not zero water, smoke, disruption, shaking or risk. RDI antenna sites do not establish radio coverage, traffic, backhaul, power/backup or availability.

REV activity and contour records are statutory context, not current substance inventory, release, fire, toxic plume, exposure, alarm or response. The ten canonical presets omit a selected industrial/external-safety event.

BRT forest is static land-use/eligibility context, not current fuel, moisture, ignition, perimeter, suppression or smoke exposure; the controlled ignition is a reproducible model test, not a real event.

Cyber lacks a named target, architecture, attack path and operator state; earthquake lacks a selected event, site-response/ground-motion surface and asset fragility; coastal zero water is only the canonical preset's narrow direct component.

Affected population is a post-network people-equivalent threshold metric while deprived person-hours is a cumulative local pre-network matched-baseline pressure proxy. Neither is identified customers, casualties, displacement, welfare loss or economic damage; six-hour checkpoints can miss rapid transitions.
Exact service percentages, local ranks and recovery paths remain synthetic exercise output until each hazard/service has a versioned calibration, uncertainty, action and evidence-state contract.
